node.statement: Take the finite direct sum over j of the bijections from node 1.4 and compose with the preceding first-index bijection. Reassociate the finite algebraic direct sums to obtain a bounded complex-linear bijection S_{v(I_B),w(I_C)}->direct-sum_{j,k}S_{v(Pi_j),w(Sigma_k)}, exactly the root conclusion.
